definition: to go away from; to leave; to depart; to exit.
example_en: He silently departed from the meeting.

definition: a cruelly malicious or playfully mischievous person.
example: ಆ ಬಚ್ಚಾಳಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಕಲ್ಲು ಎಸೆದು ಓಡಿಹೋದನು.
example_en: That mischievous rascal threw stones at the children and ran away.

definition: the tree Annona squamosa of Annonaceae family.
example_en: The custard apple fruit tastes sweet.

definition: to open a door.
example_en: I opened the door.

definition: to deal a blow or stroke to (a person or thing), as with the fist, a weapon or a hammer; to hit; to strike.
example_en: The thief struck him on the head with a stone.

definition: a style of prose composition which abounds in complex sentences, long and hard compounds.
example_en: That text is written in the utkalikāprāya style with long compounds.

definition: a man lacking a sense of responsibility; an irresponsible man.
example: ಆ ಅಲಾಲ್‍ಟೋಪಿ ಕೆಲಸಗಾರ ಮತ್ತೆ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That irresponsible worker again did not come on time.

definition: the cassia plant Cassia auriculata of Caesalpiniaceae family.
example_en: A cassia plant has grown by the side of the road.

definition: the undomesticated cat Felis chaus, a forest-inhabitant; wild-cat.
example_en: The wildcat looks like a cat.

definition: exactly in the same manner; similarly.
example: ಆ ನಟನ ಧ್ವನಿ ಮೂಲ ಗಾಯಕನಂತೆ ಹೂಬೇಹೂಬ್ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: That actor's voice was exactly similar to the original singer's.

definition: that which is of inferior quality.
example_en: That shop sells only inferior quality goods.

definition: the thin, arched, usu. wooden support on the belly of violins, lutes, guitars, etc. over which the strings are stretched; a bridge.
example_en: The violin's bridge had broken.

definition: a light meal; tiffin.
example_en: Come at four o'clock to eat tiffin.

definition: to shield from injury, danger or loss; to guard; to defend; to protect.
example_en: The soldiers protected the border from enemies.

definition: a strong desire; craving.
example_en: He has a strong craving for eating sweets.

definition: (pl.) some places.
example: ಈ ಪದ್ಧತಿ ಅರೆ ಉೞಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಚಾಲ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ.
example_en: This custom is in practice only in some places.

definition: to cause to withdraw from the worldly activities.
example_en: The guru made him withdraw from worldly activities.

definition: to dip, immerse or soak in boiling water.
example_en: Mother dipped the vegetables in boiling water.

definition: the quality, habit or fact of wandering without a permanent home or a fixed purpose; nomadism.
example_en: That tribe's nomadism has continued for centuries.

definition: a unit of measure (used in measuring grains).
example_en: They measured a sidde of rice.

definition: to move trotting as a horse.
example_en: The rider made the horse trot and moved forward.

definition: to go round (a building, property, etc.) in order to keep watch; to guard.
example_en: The watchman went round guarding the property all night.

definition: that which is sharp, keen.
example_en: The keenness of the sword split even the tree.

definition: the act of naming or calling by name.
example_en: The naming of the new child took place according to tradition.

definition: a false, deceitful statement.
example_en: Everyone was deceived by his false, deceitful statement.

definition: something established for use as a rule or basis of comparison in measuring or judging capacity, quantity, content, extent, value, quality, etc.; a standard.
example_en: A fixed standard was used for measurement.

definition: to scatter things here and there; to strew in a disorderly manner.
example_en: The children scattered the papers and strewed them all over the room.

definition: an extremely severe paroxysmal headache.
example_en: A severe splitting headache had been troubling her since morning.

definition: to kill; to end another's life.
example: ಆ ಕೊಲೆಗಾರ ಯಾವುದೇ ಕಾರಣವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಅವನ ಪ್ರಾಣ ತೆಗೆದ.
example_en: That murderer killed him without any reason.

definition: a period of decline in position, influence, prosperity or standard of living.
example: ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಎಡೆಕಾಲ ಬಂದು ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡಿತು.
example_en: A period of decline came upon that family and it lost everything.

definition: to compare one thing with the another.
example_en: The teacher compared the two answers.

definition: much hotness; great warmth.
example_en: In summer, the great heat of the sun cannot be endured.

definition: an old measure of capacity equal to one-eighth of a seer.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಗಿದ್ನ ಎಂಬ ಅಳತೆ ಬಳಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In olden times, a measure called gidna was in use.

definition: the chief officer of a village.
example_en: The village chief officer gave permission for the new crop.

definition: to stand firmly and in an upright manner.
example_en: The guard stood firmly and upright near the door.

definition: the act of sharpening (cutting weapons).
example_en: The blacksmith sharpened the sword.

definition: instead of; in lieu of.
example_en: He used jaggery instead of sugar.

definition: a highly laudatory statement, short writing, written about the author or his book printed on the back cover of the book; a blurb.
example: ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಬೆನ್ನುಡಿ ಓದಿ ನಾನು ಅದನ್ನು ಕೊಂಡೆ.
example_en: I read the blurb on the back cover of the book and bought it.

definition: a war hero.
example_en: The war hero led the king's army.

definition: the condition of somewhat dark; lack of sufficient light; dimness.
example_en: In the morning haze the hill looked faint.

definition: a smiling face.
example_en: He always talks to people with a smiling face.

definition: the birth and life of a human being.
example: ಮಾನವಜನ್ಮ ಪಡೆಯುವುದು ಒಂದು ಪುಣ್ಯ ಎಂದು ಹಿರಿಯರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The elders say that attaining human birth is a blessing.

definition: a giving to one another of similar things; an exchange.
example_en: Both of them exchanged their grains with one another.

definition: the plant Musa paradisiaca of Musaceae family.
example_en: The banana plant has grown well in the backyard.

definition: having hardness and rigidity but little tensile strength; breaking readily with a comparatively smooth fracture, as glass; brittle.
example_en: This glass is brittle and breaks easily.

definition: red; red-coloured; reddish.
example_en: The evening sky shone with a red hue.

definition: to go along or move above on a single foot.
example: ಗಾಯಗೊಂಡ ಹಕ್ಕಿ ಒಂದೇ ಕಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೂಟುತ್ತಾ ಹೋಯಿತು.
example_en: The injured bird went hopping along on a single foot.

definition: a pleasant dream; a sweet dream.
example_en: She had a sweet dream in the early morning.

definition: to cause to become abnormally thin or feeble.
example_en: The illness made his body become abnormally thin and feeble.

definition: a long-handled brush of straws, twigs, bristles,etc. for sweeping; a broom.
example_en: They swept the temple courtyard with a long-handled broom.

definition: the quality of being loose; looseness; bagginess.
example_en: Because of the looseness of that bag, the items fell out.

definition: the skin of the sesame seeds.
example_en: They separated the sesame seed skin and extracted the oil.

definition: a box or other shelter for a colony of domestic bees; beehive.
example_en: There was a beehive on the tree.

definition: to point (something) with the forefinger.
example_en: The boy pointed with his forefinger to show the way.

definition: the sound imitating the barking sound of a puppy.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ನಾಯಿಮರಿ ಲೊಳ್ ಎಂದು ಬೊಗಳಿತು.
example_en: The puppy barked 'lol' in front of the house.

definition: Lakṣmi, the consortof Viṣṇu.
example_en: The devotees worshipped Lakṣmi, the consort of Viṣṇu, with devotion.

definition: the act, process or fact of entering into; entrance.
example_en: Entrance into the fort was difficult.

definition: an eulogistic oration by panegyrists.
example_en: In the king's court the poets delivered a eulogistic oration.

definition: to speak arrogantly or boastfully; to swagger.
example: ಸೋಮಾರಿ ಹುಡುಗ ತನ್ನ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೊಮ್ಮುನುಡಿದನು.
example_en: The lazy boy boasted about his achievement.

definition: one of the eighteen minor Purāṇas.
example_en: The Sanatkumara Purana was taught to the disciples.

definition: a cow.
example_en: They tied the cow in the morning to milk it.

definition: the condition or fact of being dependent; dependence.
example: ಇತರರ ಶ್ರಯಣ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಅವನು ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He said that dependence on others is not good.

definition: the prolapsus of the terminal part of the large intestine, out of the anus.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಆತನ ಗೂದೆ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೆ ಶಸ್ತ್ರಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ ಸೂಚಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor recommended surgery for his intestinal prolapse problem.

definition: any of the crew of a ship.
example: ಆ ನೌಕಾರೋಹಿ ಬಿರುಗಾಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಧೈರ್ಯದಿಂದ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That crew member worked bravely even in the storm.

definition: the act of taking air into the lungs and letting it out (as a natural course); breathing.
example_en: Breathing is essential for living beings.

definition: with; along with; together with.
example: ಅವನು ಕುಟ್ಟೆ ಬಂದ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಊಟ ಬಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He served food to everyone who came along with him.

definition: a kind of drum, a percussion instrument.
example_en: That artist is skilled in playing the drum.

definition: the big red ant.
example_en: A big red ant was crawling on the wall.

definition: (dial.) a small earthen pot.
example_en: She filled the small earthen pot with water.

definition: the part of the body between the ribs and the hips; the waist.
example_en: He stood with his hand on his waist.

definition: the last part of the day; the period around sunset; evening.
example_en: As evening fell, the birds returned to their nests.

definition: that burns; burning.
example_en: The burning rays of the sun were scorching the earth.

definition: the plant Olea dioca of Oleaceae family; Indian wild olive.
example_en: Indian wild olive trees were found abundantly in the forest.

definition: a short stabbing weapon; a dagger.
example_en: A dagger was found with the thief.

definition: the large-sized, deciduous tree Dalbergia latifolia ( = D. emarginata) of Papilionaceae family, which is known for its valuable wood.
example_en: The carpenter used rosewood for the furniture.

definition: great valour.
example_en: The warrior's great valour amazed the people.

definition: a sitting, with the body weight being on the feet, legs folded at the knees and without resting the buttocks on the floor.
example: ಅವನು ಬಾಗಿಲ ಬಳಿ ತುರುಗಾಲು ಹಾಕಿ ಕುಳಿತನು.
example_en: He sat near the door in the turugālu posture.

definition: a married man.
example: ಆ ಗೃಹಿ ತನ್ನ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಕಷ್ಟಪಟ್ಟು ದುಡಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That married man works hard for his family.

definition: to be treated with respect; to be revered or honoured.
example_en: Everyone honoured him for his honesty.

definition: abnormal curvature of the spine resulting in a hump; a humped, deformed back; kyphosis.
example_en: As he grew old, a hump formed on his back.

definition: a person mediating between a seller and a buyer for a fee or a percentage of the sale proceeds or he who negotiates as an intermediary a contract between two or more parties for a commission; a commission agent; a broker.
example_en: There was a well-known broker in the village.

definition: the act or an instance of discharging urine.
example_en: It was difficult for the patient to urinate.

definition: (pl.) two or both the heads; both the ends.
example_en: That doll had two heads.

definition: the pole of a carriage or cart.
example_en: Because the cart's pole broke, the oxen stopped.

definition: to knit the unwoven threads at the border of a cloth.
example_en: The weaver knitted the unwoven threads at the border of the saree.

definition: the part of a flowering plant that contains the embryo with food stored for its development into a new plant under the proper conditions; a seed.
example_en: When the rain comes, the seed sprouts.

definition: to go down or rest on the knees (as in praying); to kneel.
example: ಮಗು ಅಜ್ಜನ ಮುಂದೆ ದೊಗ್ಗಾಲಿಕ್ಕಿ ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದ ಪಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The child knelt before the grandfather and received his blessing.

definition: sweat that is coming out profusely.
example: ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಕಟ್ಟುಬೆವರು ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: Working in the sun made profuse sweat pour out of him.

definition: a federation - a) an association or alliance of individuals, groups or nations formed for achieving a common purpose; b) an organisation formed by such an act; league; esp. a federal union of states, nations, etc.; a federal government.
example: ಹಲವು ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳು ಸೇರಿ ಒಂದು ಒಕ್ಕೂಟ ರಚಿಸಿದವು.
example_en: Many states joined together to form a federation.

definition: one's enemy's army.
example_en: The king's army prepared to face the enemy's army.

definition: to imitate, mimic or play like a monkey.
example: ಆ ಬಾಲಕ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ಮುಂದೆ ಕೋಡಗವಾಡಿ ನಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That boy made his friends laugh by mimicking a monkey.

definition: a large number of people assembled at a place; a group; a multitude.
example_en: A large crowd had gathered at the fair.

definition: to end; to finih; to conclude; to complete.
example_en: He completed his work on time.

definition: bending easily; flexible; supple; limber; lissome; lithe.
example: ಈ ಬಿದಿರಿನ ಕೋಲು ನಮ್ಯ ವಾಗಿ ಬಗ್ಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This bamboo stick bends flexibly.

definition: a girl adopted into one's own family by a legal process as a daughter.
example: ಆಕೆ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಪುತ್ರಿಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನೂ ನೀಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She gave all rights to her legally adopted daughter.

definition: to become deep or deeper.
example_en: The pond becomes deeper during the rainy season.

definition: a line joining the origin (i.e. observeṛs point) and the object moving on a curved line; a line from a fixed point to a point on a curve.
example_en: The mathematician calculated the orbit using the radius vector.

definition: the condition, stage or period of inaction.
example_en: The factory had fallen into a state of inaction.

definition: incessant rain.
example_en: In the monsoon, incessant rain poured without stopping.

definition: a maternity ward in a hospital or a room in a house used for the purpose.
example: ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯ ಈಱಿಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಮಗುವಿನ ಅಳು ಕೇಳಿಬಂತು.
example_en: The cry of a newborn baby was heard from the hospital's maternity ward.

definition: a kind of finger-ring.
example_en: Grandmother wore a gold finger-ring.

definition: the selling or buying of goods in relatively large quantities and usu. at lower prices than at retail; wholesale.
example_en: The shopkeeper sold rice at wholesale rate.

definition: that which conforms to fact or truth, free from error or accurate.
example_en: His accounting was exactly accurate.

definition: water coloured with saffron powder.
example_en: They offered water coloured with saffron powder to the deity.

definition: a sham quarrel in love-making between two lovers.
example_en: Their sham quarrel in love strengthened their love even more.

definition: a round, iron or steel ball to pelt against enemies in a war.
example_en: The soldiers threw an iron ball at the enemies.

definition: to plunder; to strip of everything valuable; to loot.
example_en: The enemies looted the town and carried everything away.

definition: a pleasing colour.
example_en: The pleasing colour of that painting was soothing to the eye.

definition: to utter a deep sound expressing pain, distress; to groan.
example_en: The injured animal groaned in pain.

definition: to spread (oneself) about here and there.
example_en: The seeds spread about everywhere in the wind.

definition: the fold of skin near a cobra's head that expands when the snake is excited; a cobra's hood.
example_en: The snake spread its hood in anger.

definition: a bringing into being; production; generation.
example_en: The generation of new ideas took place in the meeting.

definition: (a bird) to make its charactgeristic sound; to cry.
example_en: In the morning, the parrot cried out on the tree.

definition: a servant.
example_en: That servant was obeying his master's orders.

definition: an inclined roof in tiers.
example_en: They had covered the old house with a tiered inclined roof.

definition: relentlessness; persistent vehemence; intensified harshness.
example_en: Relentlessness was evident in his words.

definition: suicide - a) the action or an act of intentionally killing oneself; b) (fig.) any action that is destructive to one's own interests.
example_en: Unable to bear the pressure, he committed suicide.

definition: a barber's place of business; a barber-shop.
example: ಆ ಬೀದಿಯ ಕ್ಷೌರಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಜನಸಂದಣಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: There is always a crowd at the barber shop on that street.

definition: a fat sheep.
example: ಆ ಕುರುಬನ ಬಳಿ ಒಂದು ದನಗುರಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: That shepherd had a fat sheep.

definition: the hair of the head.
example_en: Her hair was flying in the wind.

definition: a flat piece, usu. rectangular, forming a part of a door, window, etc.; a panel.
example_en: They had made the window panel out of wood.

definition: to enter along with.
example_en: He too entered the meeting along with his friend.

definition: a strong wind.
example_en: The strong wind uprooted the trees.

definition: the quality of being improper, inappropriate; impropriety; inappropriateness.
example_en: The impropriety of his behaviour was visible to everyone.

definition: profusely; abundantly; plentifully.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಮಾವಿನ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳು ಬಿಬ್ಬನೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟಿವೆ.
example_en: This year mango fruits have grown abundantly.

definition: the act of consoling a grieved or disappointed person.
example_en: She was comforted by his act of consoling.

definition: the manner or state of being; condition; situation.
example_en: The state of the village is better now than before.

definition: a horizontal plane.
example_en: The foundation of the building must be flat and even.

definition: the cycle of birth, death and rebirth; chain of lives of a soul.
example_en: The cycle of birth and rebirth is unavoidable for all living beings.

definition: the branch of knowledge dealing with past events; history.
example_en: The students read the history of India with interest.

definition: the ankle of the foot.
example_en: She fell while running and her ankle swelled up.

definition: to describe or explain in detail.
example_en: The teacher explained the lesson in detail.

definition: the tree Ficus gibbosa ( = Urostigma volubile) of Moraceae family; stone fig tree.
example: ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಬುಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಗೂಡುಮಿಟ್ಲಿ ಮರ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A stone fig tree had grown at the foot of that hill.

definition: the condition of being overspread with or enveloped in dimness; gloominess.
example_en: The path could not be seen in the enveloping gloom.

definition: virtue such as being compassionate, kind, having the feeling of brotherliness, not being selfish, petty, etc.
example_en: There was no humaneness at all in him.

definition: combat troops mounted on horses.
example_en: The king's mounted troops rushed to the battlefield.

definition: a kind of drum, a percussion instrument.
example_en: The drum was played for the temple festival.

definition: the state of being convinced (completely).
example_en: I am completely convinced about his honesty.

definition: to emit black smoke.
example_en: The stove is emitting black smoke.

definition: a man who tends to complain always.
example_en: That habitual complainer always finds something to grumble about.

definition: the grass Pennisetum typhoides (= Holcus spicata, = Panicum spicatum) of Poaceae family.
example_en: Kamma grass had grown at the edge of the field.

definition: a loose fold of skin hanging from the throat of cattle and certain other animals; the dewlap.
example_en: The dewlap of that ox was hanging loosely.

definition: the action or practice of deceiving; concealment or misrepresentation of the truth in order to mislead; deception; fraud; cheating.
example_en: His deception caused a great loss in the business.

definition: that which is tied or fastened.
example_en: The boat's rope was tied firmly fastened.

definition: conflict because of differences of opinion, temperament, etc.; friction.
example_en: A conflict arose between the two of them.

definition: interest; concern (as in a matter of importance, profit, emotion, etc.).
example_en: Financial concern kept him awake at night.

definition: a flexible series of joined links, usu. in the form of rings of metal passing through one another, used to pull, confine, support, measure or transmit power; a chain.
example: ಅವನು ಬಾಗಿಲಿಗೆ ಚೈನು ಹಾಕಿ ಬೀಗ ಜಡಿದನು.
example_en: He put a chain on the door and locked it.

definition: lack of coherence; the quality or state of being incoherent; incoherence.
example_en: A clear incoherence was seen in his statements.

definition: to come to life; to start one's life.
example_en: That child came to life at dawn.

definition: a narrow opening through which bullets are shot from within.
example_en: The soldier took aim through the narrow bullet-opening.

definition: to make a sound or series of sound.
example: ಗಾಳಿ ಮರದ ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಮೃದುವಾಗಿ ಸ್ವರಗೈಯಿತು.
example_en: The wind gently made a soft sound through the tree leaves.

definition: (speaking) irrelevantly; impertinently.
example: ಆ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗೆ ಎಪರಾ ತಪರಾ ಉತ್ತರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That student answered the question irrelevantly.

definition: to cause to happen; to fulfil.
example_en: He fulfilled his dream.

definition: the fore-part or side.
example_en: The eastern side of the hill was glowing at sunrise.

definition: the ninth month in the Muslim calendar, a period of fasting from the sunrise to sunset.
example_en: The Ramzan observances were being held vigorously at the mosque.

definition: a kind of musical pipe.
example_en: The musician played the musical pipe.

definition: the belief that all events are determined by fate and are hence inevitable; fatalism.
example: ಅವನ ವಿಧಿವಾದ ಅವನನ್ನು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಮಾಡದಂತೆ ತಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: His fatalism prevented him from making any effort.

definition: rapid; swift; quick.
example_en: The fire spread rapidly to the whole house.

definition: a meeting of a number of poets where they read out their poems.
example_en: A big poets' gathering took place in the town today.

definition: a tract of land having pebbles, small irregular pieces of stones mixed with the soil.
example_en: Crops do not grow well in that pebbly land.

definition: an undomesticated, wild buffalo.
example_en: The wild buffalo roamed freely in the forest.

definition: a killing by firing a bullet or bullets at.
example_en: That shooting killing shocked the whole village.

definition: the act of deceiving; deception.
example_en: His deception was finally exposed.

definition: to be cold or chilly.
example_en: In winter, the mornings are very cold.

definition: the act of coronating or the official ceremony of coronation.
example_en: The king's coronation ceremony was held grandly.

definition: any means in or by which someone travels or something is carried or conveyed; a vehicle.
example_en: They used a vehicle to transport the goods.

definition: he who is lamenting; a man in distress.
example_en: That distressed man was weeping, having lost his family.

definition: a small spark thrown off by fire.
example_en: A small spark leapt out from the stove.

definition: Caitra, the first month in the Hindu lunar calendar.
example: ಮದು ಮಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ವರ್ಷದ ಹಬ್ಬ ಆಚರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They celebrate the new year festival in the month of Madu.

definition: a herd of calves.
example_en: A herd of calves was playing all over the cowshed.

definition: agreement in feeling, action, ideas, interests, etc.; peaceable or friendly relations; harmony; an association marked by compatibility.
example: ಗುರು ಶಿಷ್ಯರ ನಡುವೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಪೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A deep harmony had developed between the guru and disciple.

definition: the flesh of animals used as food; meat.
example_en: They brought goat meat for cooking.

definition: a repetition of words, speech uttered by another or propounding which is already established.
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಂಥದ ಅನುವಾದಕತ್ವ ಮೂಲ ಶ್ಲೋಕಗಳಿಗೆ ನಿಷ್ಠವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The repetition of the established verses in that text was faithful to the original stanzas.

definition: to place in such and such a position, state, predicament, relation, etc.; to put.
example_en: He placed the book on the table.

definition: a maxim used to describe an association, intercourse, fellowship, etc. which is so well blended, that cannot be separated easily or at all.
example_en: Their friendship can be called an inseparable blend, like water and milk.

definition: broken; shattered; disintegrated.
example_en: The house fell shattered in the earthquake.

definition: to cause to give out light; to illuminate.
example_en: The lamp illuminated the whole room.

definition: to lose weight; to get (one's burden) reduced.
example_en: After his illness he is losing a lot of weight.

definition: (masc.) a doctor who is an expert in administering antidotes; a toxicologist.
example_en: The toxicologist treated the patient who had been bitten by a snake.

definition: to emit an echo; to resound with an echo; to echo.
example_en: His voice echoed in the valley.

definition: a blood vessel that carries purified blood away from the heart.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಕಿಸುಸೆರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಶುದ್ಧ ರಕ್ತ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತದೆಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor explained that purified blood flows through the artery.

definition: the plant Syzygium zeylanicum ( = S.spicata, = Eugenia zeylanica) of Myrtaceae family.
example: ಕಾಡಿನ ಅಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಮೀನಂಗಿ ಮರ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: A Syzygium zeylanicum tree has grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: (jain.) any action that results in sensual gratification.
example: ಜೈನ ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾತವೇದನೀಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿವರಣೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: Jain texts describe the karma that results in sensual gratification.

definition: after certain point of time; afterwards; at a later time.
example_en: After the meal, we went to the garden.

definition: (hist.) a kind of tax.
example: ಆ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಜ್ಜ ಎಂಬ ತೆರಿಗೆ ರೈತರಿಂದ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In those days, a tax called bejja was collected from farmers.

definition: a turned-up nose.
example_en: Her turned-up nose enhanced her beauty.

definition: a post to which cattle are tied.
example_en: The farmer tied the ox to the post.

definition: red granite stone.
example_en: They built the house's wall with red granite stone.

definition: to render (something) useless.
example_en: The government rendered the old plan useless.

definition: an anvil on which an animal is sacrificed.
example_en: The priest sacrificed the sheep on the anvil.

definition: that which is comprehended by one's intelligence.
example_en: This truth is grasped by intelligence, and cannot be told in words.

definition: a Bhakti tradition started by Adinātha, in Mahārāṣṭra.
example_en: The Nath tradition originated in Maharashtra.

definition: a fat, corpulent man.
example: ಆ ಟೊಣಪ ಬಸ್ಸಿನ ಸೀಟಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗಲವಾಗಿ ಕುಳಿತನು.
example_en: That obese man sat broadly on the bus seat.

definition: the quality or fact of being prominent or easily seen and recognised.
example: ಅವನ ಕೆಂಪು ಶರ್ಟು ಜನರ ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಗಂಡಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His red shirt was prominently visible in the crowd of people.

definition: the bottom of a water well.
example_en: Frogs were living at the bottom of the water well.

definition: the gree Michelia nilagirica of Magnoliaceae family.
example_en: A Michelia nilagirica tree has grown on the slope of the hill.

definition: an arch. tax.
example_en: The king had the arch tax collected from the subjects.

definition: a body of people governing the affairs of a village or group of villages.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಪಂಚಾಯಿತಿ ಹೊಸ ರಸ್ತೆ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆ ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The village panchayat approved the construction of a new road.

definition: to be full of thorns.
example_en: Since that bush was full of thorns, we could not go inside.

definition: to ooze, send forth (water or any other liquid) from within.
example_en: Water is oozing from the rock beside the well.

definition: one's eldest child.
example_en: The eldest child took charge of the father's property.

definition: name of a deity.
example_en: The villagers offered worship to the deity Jokora.

definition: the long hair of yak (Bos gruniens).
example_en: The priest fanned the deity with the yak-tail whisk.

definition: without hiding or concealing; openly.
example_en: He stated his matter openly without hiding anything.

definition: he who has a thick growth of hair.
example_en: That thick-haired ascetic lived in the forest.

definition: the state of being joined together, associated firmly; an association.
example_en: The association of those two organizations became profitable.

definition: the extent of one's vision.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲಿಂದ ಅವನ ದೃಕ್ಪರಿಧಿ ಬಹಳ ದೂರದವರೆಗೆ ವಿಸ್ತರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: From atop the hill, his range of vision extended very far.

definition: to be heard.
example_en: That sound was clearly heard from a distance.

definition: day and night.
example_en: They traveled day and night and reached the town.

definition: to bend or incline the body so as to rest part of one's weight upon or against something; to lean on.
example_en: That young man is renowned as a mighty and powerful soldier.

definition: a runner, courier carrying a message from one place or person to another.
example_en: The courier brought news of the war.

definition: a name added to the existing one.
example_en: They added an additional name to his name.

definition: to push, propel (usu. a small object) forward forcefully with one finger.
example_en: She flicked the ball forward with her finger.

definition: a mound of earth, leaves, etc., formed by a colony of ants in digging or constructing their underground nest, in which snakes dwell; an ant-hill.
example_en: A new ant-hill appeared in the garden.

definition: to be caught, arrested.
example_en: The thief was caught by the police.

definition: a losing or being lost; loss.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ಭಾರೀ ಲುಕ್ಸಾನ ಆಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This year the company has incurred a huge loss.

definition: to clean by sweeping.
example_en: She swept and cleaned the courtyard.

definition: the religious merit which would bring one favourable fruits; virtue.
example_en: Virtue is obtained by giving charity.

definition: a man of knowledge or maturity; a scholarly man.
example_en: In that village, there was a scholarly teacher.

definition: a getting a position, status, office, etc.
example_en: He gained a high position in the organization.

definition: a very young child; a baby; an infant.
example_en: The baby's smile made everyone happy.

definition: a pot-bellied man.
example: ಡೊಳ್ಳುಹೊಟ್ಟೆಗನು ಊಟದ ನಂತರ ಆರಾಮ ಕುರ್ಚಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತನು.
example_en: The pot-bellied man sat in the easy chair after his meal.

definition: to go forward; to proceed.
example_en: The soldiers went forward proceeding towards the enemy.

definition: the sense organs in the body.
example_en: The ear is one among the sense organs.

definition: noisy disturbance; commotion.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಸಣ್ಣ ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ ರಗಳೆ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: A commotion arose between the two over a small matter.

definition: anything that is green, new or fresh.
example_en: During the rainy season, the field was filled with fresh greenery.

definition: an inflamed, pus-filled swelling on the skin caused by infection; a furuncle.
example: ಅವನ ಕಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಚಿಕೆ ಉಂಟಾಗಿ ನೋವು ಕೊಡುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: A boil has formed on his leg and is causing pain.

definition: to immigrate, en masse , from the normal place of living, to settle in another, permanently or for a relatively longer period (esp. necessitated by famine, disaster, etc. or by threat or coercion).
example_en: Because of the famine, the people left the village and migrated en masse.

definition: the share of a small plough or of weeding implement.
example_en: The farmer fitted the share to the plough.

definition: she who plays a vīṇe.
example: ಆ ವೀಣೆಗಾರ್ತಿ ಸಂಜೆ ಕಚೇರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಧುರವಾಗಿ ನುಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: That vīṇā player woman played sweetly at the evening concert.

definition: the form of potassium nitrate, KNO3, that occurs naturally, used in the manufacture of fireworks, fluxes, gunpowder, etc.; nitre; saltpetre.
example_en: Saltpetre is needed for gunpowder.

definition: the fact or condition of being directly perceived (as by senses) ; direct perception.
example_en: He had a direct perception of that event.

definition: any kind of medicinal powder, taken by inhaling.
example_en: Grandmother inhales medicinal powder when she has a cold.

definition: to utter a loud, deep, rumbling sound, as a lion or a person in excitement, pain, anger, etc.; to roar.
example_en: The lion roared loudly in the forest.

definition: a woman who refuses allegiance to, resists or rises in arms against the government or ruler of her country; a rebel.
example: ಆ ಬಂಡಾಯಗಾರ್ತಿ ಆಡಳಿತದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಟ ನಡೆಸಿದಳು.
example_en: That rebel woman waged a struggle against the government.

definition: the state or period of being an infant; childhood; infancy.
example_en: Her infancy passed away in poverty itself.

definition: a pole smeared with grease or oil, used in gymnastics; a greasy pole.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಹಬ್ಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಡುಗರು ಜಿಡ್ಡುಗಂಬ ಹತ್ತಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The boys tried to climb the greasy pole at the village festival.

definition: the quality of being not at ease with others or being bashful; shyness; bashfulness.
example_en: She feels bashful talking to strangers.

definition: profound thought, investigation, examination, discussion.
example: ಈ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಮೀಮಾಂಸೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದೆ.
example_en: A profound examination of this matter is necessary.

definition: the Kannaḍa poetry.
example_en: He reads Kannada poetry with love.

definition: a young cow that has not yet to give birth to (a calf).
example_en: That young cow had not yet calved.

definition: a good dress; a beautiful garment.
example_en: He wore a beautiful garment for the festival.

definition: of, relating to, endowed by Sarasvati, the Goddess of Learning, Knowledge and Speech.
example: ಆ ಕವಿಯ ಸಾರಸ್ವತ ಪ್ರತಿಭೆಯನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೊಗಳಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone praised that poet's scholarly talent.

definition: the act of throbing, pulsating.
example_en: His chest was filled with throbbing from fear.

definition: the condition of great wretchedness, suffering, helplessness, etc. and which is pitiable; misery.
example_en: Seeing the misery of the poor, the heart melted.

definition: the condition of being destroyed; destruction; demolition; annihilation.
example_en: The earthquake caused the destruction of the whole town.

definition: a person who (usu. habitually) smokes cigarettes, beedies, a pipe, etc.; a smoker.
example: ಆ ಧೂಮಪಾನಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ದಿನ ಒಂದು ಪ್ಯಾಕೆಟ್ ಸಿಗರೇಟು ಸೇದುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That smoker smokes one packet of cigarettes every day.

definition: the ninth month in the Muslim calendar, a period of fasting from the sunrise to sunset.
example_en: Muslims fast during the month of Ramadan.

definition: to undertake a contemplative, self-denying life.
example_en: That young man left family life and undertook a contemplative, self-denying life.

definition: a coercive behaviour or oppressive way of talking.
example: ಗಲ್ಲಿಯ ಗೂಂಡಾ ಜನರ ಮೇಲೆ ರೋಪು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: The street thug used to show off coercive, oppressive behaviour towards people.

definition: to repulse - a) to drive back; repel, as an attack; b) to repel with discourtesy, coldness, indifference, etc.
example_en: The army repulsed the enemies' attack.

definition: a man who speaks with involuntary pauses or blocks, often with rapid repetitions of syllables or initial sounds as a result of muscle spasms believed to result from mental conflicts; a stammerer; a stutterer.
example_en: Being a stammerer, he struggled to speak.

definition: the work of building with stone, brick, concrete or mortar, etc.; masonry.
example_en: The masonry work of that building is not yet finished.

definition: a stream, flow of river or flood that pleases the eyes.

example_en: The pleasing stream flowing below the hill delighted the eyes.

definition: the middle of the way or distance; midway.
example_en: They took rest midway.

definition: the pride of youth.
example_en: The pride of youth made him arrogant.

definition: to be excited by joy, love, success, etc.; to be carried away by such events.
example_en: In the joy of the wedding, everyone was carried away with excitement.

definition: to be suitable or proper; to be appropriate; to fit.
example_en: This remark is not suitable for this occasion.

definition: to scold, reprimand sharply.
example_en: The mother scolded her son sharply.

definition: a fine rain; drizzle.
example_en: The children played while the drizzle was falling.

definition: a dark-brown or black mineral of the mica family, found in igneous and metamorphic rocks; biotite.
example_en: This rock has layers of biotite.

definition: to move, play with, the beak.

definition: filled with; containing; consisting of.
example_en: That vessel was filled with milk.

definition: a woman of stature shorter than the normal women; a dwarf woman.
example: ಆ ಗಿಡ್ಡೆ ಎತ್ತರದ ಗೆಳತಿಯರ ನಡುವೆ ಕುಳ್ಳಗಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: That dwarf woman was short among her tall friends.

definition: to move (something) by turning (it) on an axis over and over again; to roll.
example_en: He came down the hill rolling the boulder over and over.

definition: the condition of being absent or away; absence.
example_en: The meeting's work stopped due to his absence.

definition: the quality of being strong; strength.
example_en: The elephant's strength can uproot even a big tree.

definition: the scientific study and exploration of caves; speleology.
example: ಆ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ಗುಹಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವನ್ನು ಆಸಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That student studies speleology with great interest.

definition: a man in charge of a library (usu. one trained in library science); a librarian.
example_en: The librarian arranged the new books.

definition: immediately; suddenly.
example_en: The rain began to pour suddenly.

definition: a man who appeals, esp. to a higher court against the decision of a lower court; an appellant.
example: ಅಪೀಲುದಾರ ಉಚ್ಚ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯದ ಮುಂದೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The appellant filed a petition before the high court.

definition: a children's play.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಜಿಲಿಬಿಲ್ಲಿ ಆಡುವುದೆಂದರೆ ಬಹಳ ಇಷ್ಟ.
example_en: The village children love playing jilibilli very much.

definition: insanity; unsoundness of mind.
example: ಆ ಆಘಾತದ ನಂತರ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸಸೇಮೀರ ಹಿಡಿಯಿತು.
example_en: After that shock, he fell into a state of insanity.

definition: observant care; careful attention.
example_en: The mother took up the observant care of the child.

definition: unequivocal, straight and direct speech.
example_en: He always speaks in direct, straightforward speech.

definition: a building where indoor games are played; a place of entertainment.
example_en: The children played in the indoor sports hall.

definition: to be charmed greatly; to enchanted.
example_en: Hearing that song, she was greatly enchanted.

definition: to become tight or stiff (as the limbs).
example_en: His limbs became stiff from the cold.

definition: having a thin, keen edge or fine point; sharp.
example_en: The blacksmith sharpened the sword to be keen-edged.

definition: a flat, wide, plate made intertwining thin bamboo splits.
example: ಅಡುಗೆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಡ್ಡಲಿಗೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೇಳೆ ಒಣಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The lentils were drying on the bamboo plate in the kitchen.

definition: a follower of a good, virtuous custom.

example_en: That follower of good customs faithfully followed the teacher's word.

definition: a member of the bird of the genus akin to owl; screech owl.
example_en: The screech owl was hooting at night.

definition: any of the nations of Europian or Americaan continent.
example_en: Winter is very harsh in many western countries.

definition: a formal dinner (esp. for an officer or a man of status); a banquet.
example_en: A grand banquet was arranged in honour of the officer.

definition: to go out of sight; to disappear.
example_en: The moon disappeared behind the cloud.

definition: to move aside allowing another to pass by or through.
example: ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನರು ಬೞಿವಿಟ್ಟು ಅವನಿಗೆ ದಾರಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The people on the road moved aside and made way for him.

definition: a red scar, spot or stain.
example_en: A red scar remained at the site of that wound.

definition: all occasions, times.
example_en: Worship of god goes on at all times.

definition: a small stone pieces with round, and smooth surface, tossed from the back of, and held by the palm, in a children's play.
example_en: The children played the stone-tossing game in the courtyard and were happy.

definition: to assemble; to join together; to gather.
example: ಹಬ್ಬಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಊರ ಜನರು ಗುಡಿಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಒರ್ಗಿದರು.
example_en: The villagers assembled in front of the temple for the festival.

definition: to be subjected; to be dominated, influenced by another.
example_en: He submitted himself to the teacher's words.

definition: the quality of being equal to or excelling another.
example_en: There was a debate about the equality or superiority between the two competitors.

definition: a diffusing or extending through the whole of.
example: ಆ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದ ಅಂತರ್ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಿಗೂ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: That theory's diffusion extended to all fields.

definition: the plant Sida indica.
example_en: They have grown a Sida indica plant in front of the house.

definition: the condition of being rich; wealthiness; opulence.
example_en: The wealthiness of that family was famous throughout the village.

definition: an arrogant enemy.
example_en: The arrogant enemy did not listen to anyone.

definition: (astrol.) the third astrological house.
example_en: The astrologer explained the result of the third astrological house.

definition: the science of diagnosing, treating, curing, and preventing disease, relieving pain, and improving and preserving health; medicine.
example_en: He is studying medicine.

definition: to penetrate or wound with a sharp-edged instrument.
example_en: He wounded his hand with a knife.

definition: a piece of furniture or a part of a vehicle to sit on; a seat.
example_en: One seat was empty in the train.

definition: that which conceals or keeps (something) from being seen; a screen; a veil.
example: ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಣಿ ಯನ್ನು ಇಟ್ಟು ಮರೆಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They placed a screen in front of the box and concealed it.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: A thorny yalaga tree had grown near the fence.

definition: the quality of being able to be liquefied.
example_en: This metal has a high quality of being liquefiable.

definition: the bushy or small sized plant Helicteres isora of Sterculiaceae family; East Indian screw pine.
example_en: A screw pine plant had grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: the state of being upside down; the state of reversed position.
example_en: All the things inside the house were in an upside-down state.

definition: to surround from all or almost all side; to encircle.
example_en: The soldiers surrounded the village and captured the enemies.

definition: (one's) left shoulder.
example_en: He carried the bag on his left shoulder.

definition: the condition of great success, ample wealth, etc.
example_en: That merchant's family attained great prosperity.

definition: relieving, helping to get relieve, from the hardships of the worldly life and from the agony of the cycle of births and deats.
example_en: The sage's teaching shows the path that relieves one from worldly bondage.

definition: the condition of being stiff, tight, inflexible.
example_en: Due to the cold, his hands and legs became stiff.

definition: radiant or luminous brightness; brilliance; lustre.
example_en: The lake water was shining with the brilliance of the sun.

definition: to glean, collect.
example_en: The farmer was gleaning and collecting the fallen grains in the field.

definition: a vehicle with two wheels in tandem, usu. propelled by pedals connected to the rear wheel by a chain, and having handlebars for steering and a saddlelike seat; a bicycle.
example: ಅವನು ಪ್ರತಿ ದಿನ ಸೈಕಲ್ಲು ತುಳಿದು ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He rides a bicycle to school every day.

definition: the analysis of the inner feelings.
example: ಗುರುಗಳು ಶಿಷ್ಯನ ಆಂತರ್ಯವಿಚಾರ ಮಾಡಿ ಸಲಹೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The teacher analysed the disciple's inner feelings and gave advice.

definition: to show hospitality.
example_en: They showed hospitality to the guests.

definition: (deog.) the face of a person.
example_en: His face had turned red with anger.

definition: a man having good, pleasing behaviour.
example_en: That good-natured man behaved lovingly with everyone.

definition: a short, sleeveless garment worn over the upper garment; a waistcoat.
example_en: In winter he wore a woollen waistcoat.

definition: showy display; snobbish behaviour; disdainful pride; haughtiness; snobbery.
example_en: Seeing his haughty display, all the villagers were annoyed.

definition: relating to evening or the period of time about the sunset.
example: ಆ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಂಧ್ಯ ಪೂಜೆ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Evening worship takes place every day in that temple.

definition: a unit of linear measure equal to 12 inches; a foot.
example: ಆ ಕೋಣೆಯ ಉದ್ದ ಹತ್ತು ಫೂಟು ಇದೆ.
example_en: The length of that room is ten feet.

definition: to explain or talk about (something) in detail.
example_en: The officer explained the plan in detail.

definition: a riding on a horse; a journey by horse; a horse-ride.
example_en: He is very fond of horse-riding.

definition: to tend to come near.
example: ದೂರದಿಂದಲೇ ಅವನು ಕೈಪಾರಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಬಳಿಗೆ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: He came closer to us from a distance.

definition: the act of destroying; an instance of being destroyed; downfall; destruction; devastation.
example_en: The flood caused the destruction of the entire town.

definition: the act of tearing or pulling out by the roots.
example: ಆತ ಕಳೆಗಿಡಗಳ ಮೀಂಟು ಮಾಡಿ ಹೊಲ ಸ್ವಚ್ಛಗೊಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He cleaned the field by tearing out the weeds by the roots.

definition: a man belonging to business community.
example_en: The business-community man was running a shop in the market.

definition: a variety of jujube tree (Rhamnaceae family).
example: ಅವನ ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಲಗುಬದರಿ ಮರವು ಫಲ ಬಿಟ್ಟಿದೆ.
example_en: The lagubadari jujube tree in his garden has borne fruit.

definition: the art of dance.
example_en: She had become an expert in the art of dance.

definition: having, being or recurring innumerable times.
example: ಅವನ ಪುಣ್ಯಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು ಅನಂತಮಡಿ ಫಲ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Scripture says his virtuous deeds yield innumerable-fold fruit.

definition: a small house or box with compartments for nesting pigeons; a dove-cot.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮೇಲ್ಛಾವಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾರಿವಾಳಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಒಂದು ವಿಟಂಕ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: They have built a dove-cot on the roof of the house for the pigeons.

definition: (dial.) cold wind blowing from the west during winter season.
example_en: In winter, the cold west wind blows.

definition: the work or process of manufacturing metal wires.
example: ಆ ಪಟ್ಟಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಬಚ್ಚುಗಜ್ಜ ಹಲವು ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಜೀವನೋಪಾಯವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In that town, wire manufacturing was the livelihood of many families.

definition: to contain a poison; to be or become poisonous.
example_en: That snake's bite contains poison.

definition: a man who journeys to a shrine or sacred place as a religious act; a pilgrim.
example_en: The pilgrim set out walking to the sacred shrine.

definition: a practice that is habituated.
example: ಪ್ರತಿವರ್ಷ ಹಬ್ಬಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿಹಿ ಮಾಡುವುದು ನಮ್ಮ ಮಾಮೂಲ್.
example_en: Making sweets for the festival every year is our habituated practice.

definition: any of various families of winged hymenopteran insects, characterised by a slender body with the abdomen having narrow stalk, biting mouthparts, and, in the females and workers, a vicious sting that can be used repeatedly; a wasp.
example: ಕೆಂಪುದುಂಬಿ ಕಚ್ಚಿದರೆ ನೋವು ಬಹಳ ದಿನಗಳವರೆಗೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: If a wasp stings, the pain lasts for many days.

definition: a scolding or chastising using harsh words.
example_en: The teacher scolded the lazy student with harsh words.

definition: the quality or fact of being equal to another in ability, capacity, talent, efficiency, etc.
example_en: There was equality of ability between the two runners.

definition: the treasury of a government; the state treasury.
example_en: The government released funds from the state treasury.

definition: to bundle or fill in a large jute bag and tie or sew the mouth.
example_en: The labourers bundled the cotton into a sack and stored it.
